expanded_query: This course is designed for individuals new to management who seek to develop effective negotiation and persuasion skills. Prerequisites include a basic understanding of business principles and communication skills. The course will cover topics such as active listening, assertive communication, and conflict resolution, as well as strategies for building rapport, making persuasive arguments, and negotiating mutually beneficial agreements. Through a combination of lectures, discussions, and role-playing exercises, participants will learn to analyze situations, identify key stakeholders, and develop a persuasive approach to achieve their goals. The target duration of this course is 12 hours, and upon completion, participants will be able to apply these skills in real-world scenarios to enhance their professional relationships and achieve successful outcomes.

Here is the rewritten paragraph:

This course covers the fundamental principles of electrical engineering, focusing on circuits, signals, and electronics. Prerequisites include a basic understanding of algebra and trigonometry, as well as prior experience with electronics or circuit analysis. Students will develop skills in analyzing and designing electrical circuits, understanding signal processing and transmission, and working with electronic devices and systems. Topics include circuit laws, network analysis, signal representation, and electronic device operation, with an emphasis on problem-solving and hands-on application. The course is designed for students with a strong foundation in mathematics and a basic understanding of electronics, and is expected to take approximately 12 weeks to complete.

This course is designed for learners who want to develop their skills in creative writing and storytelling for fiction. By the end of the course, learners will be able to write a complete short story or novel chapter, and will have a solid foundation for continued writing and storytelling development.

expanded_query: This course provides an introduction to the fundamental principles of law and legal reasoning, designed for individuals without a legal background. Students will develop an understanding of the structure and function of the legal system, including the role of courts, judges, and lawyers, as well as the key concepts of torts, contracts, and property law. Through a combination of lectures, discussions, and case studies, learners will acquire the skills to analyze and interpret legal information, identify key issues and arguments, and develop effective reasoning and problem-solving skills. Prerequisites include a basic understanding of English and a willingness to engage with complex concepts, and the course is designed to be completed within 12-16 hours.

expanded_query: This course explores the fundamental principles and concepts of human rights and international humanitarian law, examining the historical and philosophical underpinnings of these fields. Prerequisites include a basic understanding of international law and human rights principles. Students will develop skills in analyzing and applying international human rights and humanitarian law to real-world scenarios, including the ability to identify and distinguish between different types of human rights violations and the application of international humanitarian law in conflict situations. The course targets a duration of 12 weeks, with a focus on in-depth analysis and critical thinking.

expanded_query: To develop foundational Chinese language skills for business travel, this course is designed for learners with no prior experience. Students will acquire essential vocabulary and grammar to communicate effectively in everyday situations, including basic phrases, numbers, and common expressions. Topics will cover Chinese characters, tones, and pronunciation, as well as business-related phrases and etiquette. The course will also focus on developing listening and speaking skills through interactive exercises and role-playing. By the end of the course, learners will be able to hold basic conversations, read and write Chinese characters, and navigate everyday business situations in China.
